tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Alias of list_plans. Same catalog, same prices, no extra claims.

tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.description: What StaffBots is, who it is for, and how the 14-day trial works. Copy comes from the published site facts. No tenant data.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: Industry pages published on staffbots.ai, with titles and URLs. No extra claims.

tools.name: compare_to
tools.description: Return the published comparison page for a competitor already on staffbots.ai (Onfleet, DailyDSP, DSP Workplace, Virtual Dispatcher, offshore VA agencies, AI receptionist tools, or an in-house dispatcher). The excerpt is the page text. Do not add claims.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search llms-full.txt and the public markdown mirrors. Returns titles, URLs, and short snippets.

tools.description: Get details for one StaffBots plan or add-on. Accepted values: starter, dispatch, biab (or 'business in a box'), reseller, supervisor (Human Supervisor add-on).

tools.description: Recommend a StaffBots plan from business type, optional team size, and needs (dispatch, support, scheduling, lead follow-up, admin, reseller). tools.description: Compare StaffBots AI virtual assistants with hiring a typical offshore VA or dispatcher. Uses official StaffBots prices and typical 2026 third-party market ranges — not StaffBots-verified savings or testimonials.

tools.description: Search official StaffBots FAQ answers about plans, pricing, resellers, StaffBots OS, contact, and brand disambiguation versus StaffBot at staffbot.ai.

tools.description: Collect a demo or walkthrough request (name, email, company, message, plan interest) and email it to hello@staffbots.ai. When email is not configured, the request is stored for the team instead.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_industries, search_docs, shield_check, get_agent_shield_checkout_link, get_checkout_link · Private data: faq_search · Public sink: get_agent_shield, get_agent_shield_checkout_link, book_demo_link, book_demo_request · Destructive: get_agent_shield, shield_check, shield_approval_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_industries, search_docs, shield_check, get_agent_shield_checkout_link, get_checkout_link · Private data: faq_search · Public sink: get_agent_shield, get_agent_shield_checkout_link, book_demo_link, book_demo_request · Destructive: get_agent_shield, shield_check, shield_approval_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
